message: kukulu_mutate on a Python file with a same-length replacement (DELETE->UNLIKE) restored the source but left a stale __pycache__ .pyc (same size and mtime second), so the confirmKill rerun and every later test run still saw the mutant; the result was falsely 'inconclusive' and the suite stayed red until I deleted __pycache__ by hand. The tool should remove or invalidate .pyc files (e.g. PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 or bump mtime) when it restores.

kukulu_mutate with a same-length find/replace (the PLAN-prescribed if/elif swap in api.py) restored the source within the same mtime second, leaving a stale __pycache__ .pyc of the mutant; confirmKill then reported 'inconclusive' and the next verify failed on the clean tree. Same root cause as round 1's friction entry: the tool should clear or invalidate __pycache__ (or bump mtime) on restore.
